holdout.title: Beijing PM2.5
holdout.selection: first 120 CSV data rows with finite numeric pm2.5, skipping NA; preserve original scalar text; no selection by adapter outcome

source_numeric_text: Original selected scalar strings are retained in canonical truth. Explicit transport-locale variants are derived and expected to normalize to the same decimal value.
holdout_rules: No third-source data bytes may be downloaded or read before final six-adapter plus Host plus PDF-bridge freeze.
Read only official metadata before final freeze.
First holdout adapter run timestamp/run ID must be recorded, and no second adaptive run is permitted.
Observed failures remain results; no post-holdout parser correction.

duplicate_contract.cross_file_same: canonical identity idempotent, no extra insertion
duplicate_contract.cross_file_conflict: reject conflicting file atomically; earlier committed file retained
